name: lookup_entry
description: What the record holds for one MCP server, skill or plugin: versions on record, the tools read from the pinned version, how many releases changed the small print and the worst grade, and the advisories that name it.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: The entry, by registry name, for example npm:@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem

name: changed_since_approval
description: Whether an entry's small print changed since the version, content hash or date that was reviewed. The answer opens with UNCHANGED, CHANGED or UNKNOWN, then the releases that changed.

arguments.name: approved
arguments.desc: A version as published, a content hash from an earlier answer, or an ISO date

name: changes_since
description: The releases of one entry whose tool descriptions, schemas or instructions changed, each with its diff, its grade and the rule that graded it.

arguments.name: since
arguments.desc: Optional ISO date; only releases published on or after it

arguments.name: min_severity
arguments.desc: Lowest grade to include: info, low, medium, high or critical

name: advisories_for
description: Every public security advisory on record that names one entry, each attributed to the database or report that published it, with its severity and the affected version range.

arguments.name: version
arguments.desc: Optional version to read the affected ranges against
